WorkspaceMenu.note: Five rows in a popover surface with icons and a destructive-tinted delete row; rounded hover pills, truncating labels and correct 12px row type.

WithTrailing.note: trailing ShortcutBadge on each row, right-aligned in the muted role — reads exactly like the product's command menu.

WithDescription.note: children render as the second line under the label, indented past the icon slot in the muted 11px role. Renders whole for both rows.

Densities.note: default vs compact labelled side by side; the padding difference is visible and the axis is real.

Disabled.note: Disabled rows dim and drop the hover fill while an enabled row above keeps full contrast.
